    Always pass `query` to filter by keyword unless the user specifically
    wants to browse the whole catalog page by page.

tools.description:
Return a GDEX portal-wide metric.

                total_citations, gdex_volume, total_requests, top_datasets, ai_datasets

tools.name: validate_subset_request

    without submitting anything. Use this before submit_subset_request to catch
    missing or unrecognized fields fast, instead of finding out from a failed
    API call.

    Args:
        dsid: Dataset ID (dNNNNNN), e.g. d08

tools.description:

tools.name: purge_request
tools.description:
Delete a subsetting request and its output files. Requires GDEX_TOKEN.

    Args:
        rindex: Request index/ID to purge

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_file_groups, get_dataset_files, get_data_access, has_arco, get_arco_variables, search_arco_variables · Private data: get_file_groups, get_dataset_files, find_dataset_files, get_filesearch_datatypes, get_filesearch_grid_filters, get_filesearch_cyclone_fix_filters, get_filesearch_sensor_filters, get_filesearch_grid_files, get_filesearch_cyclone_fix_files, get_filesearch_sensor_files, get_filesearch_result_page, has_arco, get_staff, get_request_files, get_control_file_template, validate_subset_request, submit_and_wait_for_request, purge_request · Public sink: submit_subset_request, submit_and_wait_for_request · Destructive: get_file_groups, submit_and_wait_for_request, purge_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_file_groups, get_dataset_files, get_data_access, has_arco, get_arco_variables, search_arco_variables · Private data: get_file_groups, get_dataset_files, find_dataset_files, get_filesearch_datatypes, get_filesearch_grid_filters, get_filesearch_cyclone_fix_filters, get_filesearch_sensor_filters, get_filesearch_grid_files, get_filesearch_cyclone_fix_files, get_filesearch_sensor_files, get_filesearch_result_page, has_arco, get_staff, get_request_files, get_control_file_template, validate_subset_request, submit_and_wait_for_request, purge_request · Public sink: submit_subset_request, submit_and_wait_for_request · Destructive: get_file_groups, submit_and_wait_for_request, purge_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
